interrupt.question: Allow the agent to write pwm_pa8.c (1629 bytes) to the workspace?

payload.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/pwm_pa8.c
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+#include "stm32g4xx.h"
+
+/**
+ * @brief Initialize TIM1 Channel 1 (PA8) for 20 kHz PWM with 25% duty cycle.
+ *        System clock is assumed to be 170 MHz (all APB prescalers = 1).
+ */
+void tim1_pa8_pwm_init(void) {
+    /* 1. Enable peripheral clocks for GPIOA and TIM1 */
+    RCC->AHB2ENR |= RCC_AHB2ENR_GPIOAEN;
+    RCC->APB2ENR |= RCC_APB2ENR_TIM1EN;
+
+    /* 2. Configure PA8 in Alternate Function mode (AF6 -> TIM1_CH1) */
+    GPIOA->MODER &= ~GPIO_MODER_MODE8_Msk;
+    GPIOA->MODER |= (2U << GPIO_MODER_MODE8_Pos); /* AF mode (b10) */
+
+    GPIOA->AFR[1] &= ~(0xFU << GPIO_AFRH_AFSEL8_Pos);
+    GPIOA->AFR[1] |= (6U << GPIO_AFRH_AFSEL8_Pos);  /* AF6 */
+
+    /* 3. Configure Time Base:
+     *    TIM1_CLK = 170 MHz
+     *    Target frequency = 20 kHz
+     *    Period = (PSC + 1) * (ARR + 1) / TIM1_CLK
+     *    PSC = 0
+     *    ARR = 8499 -> Period = (0 + 1) * 8500 / 170,000,000 = 1 / 20,000 s (20 kHz)
+     */
+    TIM1->PSC = 0U;
+    TIM1->ARR = 8499U;
+
+    /* 4. Configure Channel 1:
+     *    Duty cycle = 25% -> CCR1 = 8500 * 0.25 = 2125
+     *    PWM mode 1 (OC1M = 0110b): Active while CNT < CCR1, inactive when CNT >= CCR1
+     *    Enable output compare preload (OC1PE)
+     */
+    TIM1->CCR1 = 2125U;
+    TIM1->CCMR1 &= ~TIM_CCMR1_OC1M_Msk;
+    TIM1->CCMR1 |= (6U << TIM_CCMR1_OC1M_Pos) | TIM_CCMR1_OC1PE;
+
+    /* 5. Enable Channel 1 output */
+    TIM1->CCER |= TIM_CCER_CC1E;
+
+    /* 6. Enable Main Output (MOE bit in BDTR, required for advanced timer TIM1) */
+    TIM1->BDTR |= TIM_BDTR_MOE;
+
+    /* 7. Enable Auto-reload Preload (ARPE) and Counter Enable (CEN) */
+    TIM1->CR1 |= TIM_CR1_ARPE | TIM_CR1_CEN;
+}
